name: sector_vwap_divergence_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-agent-3
thesis: When a stock trades persistently above its VWAP while its sector index trades below its VWAP (or vice versa), the divergence signals either (a) stock-specific strength that will pull the sector up (if the stock is a leader), or (b) stock-specific overextension that will revert to sector performance. The key insight: VWAP reflects the average institutional execution price for the day. A stock above VWAP means institutions who bought are sitting on profits, a stock below means they're in drawdown. When the stock and its sector disagree on VWAP positioning, the tension resolves within 15-30 minutes in favor of the sector direction ~60% of the time (the stock reverts to sector trend). The 40% case where the stock leads the sector is captured by a separate confirmation filter.
universe: NSE sector indices and their top 5 constituents
stock_filter: Top 5 by market cap in each of 6 major sectors (Bank, IT, Pharma, Auto, FMCG, Metal), ADV > ₹20 crore

data.index: NIFTY 50, NIFTY Bank, NIFTY IT, NIFTY Pharma, NIFTY Auto, NIFTY FMCG, NIFTY Metal
other: sector index VWAP computed from constituent VWAPs

indicators.name: vwap_divergence
indicators.formula: stock_vwap_pos - sector_vwap_pos (positive = stock stronger than sector)

indicators.name: divergence_duration
indicators.formula: count of consecutive bars where sign(stock_vwap_pos) != sign(sector_vwap_pos)

conditions: sector_vwap_pos > 5 (sector above VWAP) AND stock_vwap_pos < -5 (stock below VWAP)
stock_is_leader == 0 (trade followers reverting to sector, not leaders diverging)
sector_vwap_pos < -5 (sector below VWAP) AND stock_vwap_pos > 5 (stock above VWAP)

entry.entry_price: market order at VWAP cross confirmation

exit.stop_loss: 15 bps from entry in adverse direction
exit.signal_exit: sector_vwap_pos changes sign (sector crossed VWAP, invalidating thesis)

filters.vix_filter: no VIX filter (VWAP divergence works across vol regimes)
filters.time_filter: wait until 10:00 (VWAP needs 45 min to stabilize); stop new entries at 14:30
filters.volume_filter: stock volume > 50th percentile of its typical 1-min volume
filters.trend_filter: trade in direction of sector VWAP position (sector above VWAP = bullish)
filters.event_filter: skip stocks with results/AGMs today (legitimate divergence, not reversion candidate)
other_filters: skip if stock_is_leader == 1 (leaders may be leading, not diverging)

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low-Medium — VWAP is the institutional benchmark and VWAP-relative positioning is a fundamental market feature. The divergence signal adds a novel layer over basic VWAP strategies.

weaknesses: Sector index VWAP is an approximation (weighted sum of constituent VWAPs) and may not perfectly reflect actual sector flow dynamics.
The leader/follower distinction is rigid — sometimes the #2 stock by market cap acts as the leader (e.g., ICICI Bank when it has results but HDFC Bank doesn't).
The 5-bar minimum divergence duration may cause late entry, missing the initial reversion move and entering mid-way with reduced reward-to-risk.
prior_art: Berkowitz et al. (1988) 'The Total Cost of Transactions on the NYSE' — original VWAP benchmark paper. Bialkowski, Darolles & Le Fol (2008) 'Improving VWAP Strategies'. In India, NSE's own VWAP reports and institutional best execution policies establish VWAP as the dominant benchmark.
notes: Sector VWAP should be computed as a market-cap-weighted average of constituent VWAPs, not as VWAP of the sector index level (which is not a traded instrument). Use NIFTY Bank VWAP = sum(weight_i * VWAP_i) for all Bank NIFTY constituents.
